acceptance_criteria: D1: New internal/mission/rolemodels/rolemodels.go imports standard library only. AllowedOpenAI is []string{"gpt-6.1-sol"}, citing D-FLEET-12 item 1 and dormant registry models. CanonicalKey lowercases, strips one leading <word>: then openai/, deletes hyphen/dot/underscore; IsOpenAI recognizes canonical gpt prefix, raw astra substring or codex: prefix; Allowed preserves non-OpenAI models. SpawnOverrideKey is features.multi_agent_v2.expose_spawn_agent_model_overrides. No imports of quorum, modelreg, executor or cmd; no cycle.

CanonicalKey table: gpt-6.1-sol, gpt6-1-sol, codex:gpt-6.1-sol, openai/gpt-6.1-sol, GPT-6.1-SOL all gpt61sol; gpt-6-astra and gpt6-astra equal; gpt-6-sol differs from gpt-6.1-sol. Allowed table permits gpt-6.1-sol and claude-opus-5-5/kimi-k3/glm-5.3/gemini-4-argon, refuses gpt-6-astra/gpt6-astra/codex:gpt-6-sol/gpt-6-luna/gpt-5.6-sol.

Other config keys retained; help mentions allowlist.
